steps.name: environment - install JDK and Android command-line tools (idempotent, validated)
steps.description: Install OpenJDK 17 (fallback to 11), ensure unzip/zip present, download and layout Android command-line tools under /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest, install platform-tools (adb), required build-tools and platforms, validate sdkmanager binary exists and licenses are accepted non-interactively (fail with clear message if not). Persist ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/ANDROID_HOME/JAVA_HOME and append SDK bins to PATH via /etc/profile.d/android-sdk.sh using a literal $PATH so future shells receive correct environment. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-mobile-283707-283716/tic_tac_toe_native_app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-mobile-283707-283716/tic_tac_toe_native_app"
SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
CLI_ZIP="/tmp/commandlinetools-linux_latest.zip"
CMDLINE_URL="https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-latest.zip"
RETRIES=3
SLEEP=3
# Ensure minimal packages
sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends unzip zip || true
# Install JDK 17 or fallback 11; validate version
if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if sudo apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk; then :; else sudo apt-get install -y openjdk-11-jdk; fi
fi
JAVA_VER_RAW=$(java -version 2>&1 | head -n1 || true)
if echo "$JAVA_VER_RAW" | grep -qE 'openjdk .*"1?[17]'; then :; else
  echo "Unsupported java version: $JAVA_VER_RAW; require OpenJDK 11 or 17" >&2
  exit 2
fi
# Compute JAVA_HOME reliably
JAVA_BIN="$(command -v javac || true)"
if [ -n "$JAVA_BIN" ]; then
  JAVA_HOME_VAL="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$JAVA_BIN")")")"
else
  echo "javac not found after install" >&2; exit 3
fi
# Prepare SDK root
sudo mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT" && sudo chmod 0775 "$SDK_ROOT"
# Download cmdline-tools with retries and timeout
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt "$RETRIES" ]; do
  if curl --fail --connect-timeout 10 -sSL -o "$CLI_ZIP" "$CMDLINE_URL"; then break; fi
  i=$((i+1)); sleep $SLEEP
done
if [ ! -f "$CLI_ZIP" ]; then echo "Failed to download cmdline-tools" >&2; exit 4; fi
# Unpack idempotently
rm -rf /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp || true
unzip -q "$CLI_ZIP" -d /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp
sudo mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest"
# The archive may contain 'cmdline-tools' dir; copy contents under latest
if [ -d /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp/cmdline-tools ]; then
  sudo cp -a /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp/cmdline-tools/* "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/"
else
  sudo cp -a /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp/* "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/"
fi
sudo chmod -R a+rX "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools" "$SDK_ROOT"
# Validate sdkmanager binary exists and is executable
SDKMAN="$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
if [ ! -x "$SDKMAN" ]; then echo "sdkmanager binary missing at $SDKMAN" >&2; exit 5; fi
# Ensure platform-tools (adb) installed via sdkmanager
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK_ROOT"
# Use non-interactive sdkmanager calls with retries
pkgs=("platform-tools" "platforms;android-33" "build-tools;33.0.2")
for p in "${pkgs[@]}"; do
  attempts=0
  until [ $attempts -ge $RETRIES ]; do
    if "$SDKMAN" --sdk_root="$SDK_ROOT" --install "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
    attempts=$((attempts+1)); sleep $SLEEP
  done
done
# Accept licenses non-interactively; fail if cannot accept
if ! yes | "$SDKMAN" --sdk_root="$SDK_ROOT" --licenses >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "sdkmanager --licenses failed; interactive acceptance required or network issue" >&2
  exit 6
fi
# Persist environment: write literal $PATH so it's expanded at shell startup
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/android-sdk.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# Android SDK and Java environment for headless builds
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
export ANDROID_HOME="/opt/android-sdk"
export PATH="/opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools:$PATH"
export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME}"
EOF
# Replace ${JAVA_HOME} placeholder with computed value using sudo-aware write
sudo sed -i "s|\${JAVA_HOME}|$JAVA_HOME_VAL|g" /etc/profile.d/android-sdk.sh
sudo chmod +x /etc/profile.d/android-sdk.sh
# Ensure adb now available
if ! command -v adb >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -x "$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools/adb" ]; then
  sudo ln -sf "$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools/adb" /usr/local/bin/adb || true
fi
# Final validations
command -v java >/dev/null || { echo "java missing" >&2; exit 7; }
[ -x "$SDKMAN" ] || { echo "sdkmanager missing after install" >&2; exit 8; }
command -v adb >/dev/null || { echo "adb missing" >&2; exit 9; }

steps.name: scaffolding - create minimal Android Gradle project with manifest and Activity
steps.description: Create a minimal Android app project under the workspace (settings.gradle, top-level build.gradle, app module with AndroidManifest.xml and MainActivity.java) only if project missing. Create directories correctly (do not include filenames in mkdir). Ensure gradle wrapper exists; if system gradle present generate wrapper, otherwise create wrapper files (properties pointing to Gradle 7.6 distribution) and download wrapper jar with retries. Validate ./gradlew --version to ensure Gradle 7.6 compatibility. Produce a start helper script in workspace/start.sh. Operates in workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-mobile-283707-283716/tic_tac_toe_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE" || mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Skip if project already exists
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/settings.gradle" ] || [ -f "$WORKSPACE/build.gradle" ]; then exit 0; fi
cat > settings.gradle <<'S'
rootProject.name = 'tic_tac_toe_native_app'
include ':app'
S
cat > build.gradle <<'G'
buildscript { repositories { google(); mavenCentral() } dependencies { classpath 'com.android.tools.build:gradle:7.4.2' } }
allprojects { repositories { google(); mavenCentral() } }
G
# Create app module directories (do not include filenames in mkdir)
mkdir -p app/src/main/java/com/example/tictactoe app/src/main/res/layout app/src/test/java/com/example/tictactoe
cat > app/build.gradle <<'A'
apply plugin: 'com.android.application'
android {
  compileSdkVersion 33
  defaultConfig { applicationId 'com.example.tictactoe'; minSdkVersion 21; targetSdkVersion 33; versionCode 1; versionName '1.0' }
  buildTypes { release { minifyEnabled false } }
}
dependencies { implementation fileTree(dir: 'libs', include: ['*.jar']) }
A
# Write manifest (separate from mkdir)
cat > app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml <<'M'
<manifest package="com.example.tictactoe" xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
  <application android:label="tic-tac-toe">
    <activity android:name=".MainActivity">
      <intent-filter>
        <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
        <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
      </intent-filter>
    </activity>
  </application>
</manifest>
M
# Minimal Activity
cat > app/src/main/java/com/example/tictactoe/MainActivity.java <<'J'
package com.example.tictactoe;
import android.app.Activity; import android.os.Bundle; import android.widget.TextView;
public class MainActivity extends Activity {
  @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle s) { super.onCreate(s); TextView v=new TextView(this); v.setText("tic-tac-toe placeholder"); setContentView(v); }
}
J
# Ensure gradle wrapper
if command -v gradle >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gradle wrapper --gradle-version 7.6 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
else
  mkdir -p gradle/wrapper
  cat > gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties <<'P'
distributionUrl=https\://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-7.6-bin.zip
P
  # download wrapper jar with retries
  RETRIES=3; SLEEP=2; i=0
  while [ $i -lt $RETRIES ]; do
    if curl --fail --connect-timeout 10 -sSL -o gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper/7.6/gradle-wrapper-7.6.jar; then break; fi
    i=$((i+1)); sleep $SLEEP
  done
  if [ ! -f gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar ]; then echo "Failed to obtain gradle wrapper jar" >&2; exit 10; fi
  if [ ! -f gradlew ]; then
    cat > gradlew <<'W'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd -P)"
exec java -jar "$DIR/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" "$@"
W
    chmod +x gradlew
  fi
fi
# Validate wrapper produces expected Gradle version
if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then
  ./gradlew --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "gradle wrapper not functional" >&2; exit 11; }
fi
# Start helper
cat > "$WORKSPACE/start.sh" <<'S'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then ./gradlew assembleDebug; else echo "No gradlew available; install gradle or use system gradle"; fi
S
chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/start.sh"

WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-mobile-283707-283716/tic_tac_toe_native_app"

package com.example.tictactoe;
import org.junit.Test; import static org.junit.Assert.*;
public class MainTest { @Test public void sample() { assertTrue(true); } }
T
# Safely insert junit dependency and testOptions using python to avoid corrupting build.gradle
python3 - <<'PY'
import io,sys,re
p='app/build.gradle'
s=open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8').read()
if 'junit:junit:4.13.2' not in s:
    # try to insert into existing dependencies block
    m=re.search(r'(^\s*dependencies\s*\{)', s, flags=re.M)
    if m:
        idx=m.end()
        s=s[:idx]+"\n    testImplementation \"junit:junit:4.13.2\""+s[idx:]
    else:
        s += "\n// test deps added by setup\ndependencies { testImplementation \"junit:junit:4.13.2\" }\n"
# ensure testOptions exists under android block
if 'testOptions' not in s:
    m=re.search(r'(^\s*android\s*\{)', s, flags=re.M)
    if m:
        idx=m.end()
        s=s[:idx]+"\n  testOptions { unitTests { includeAndroidResources = false } }\n"+s[idx:]
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
PY

steps.description: Build debug APK via ./gradlew assembleDebug, locate APK under app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk and validate it's non-empty. If adb and a device are available, handle device states (device/unauthorized/offline) clearly, attempt adb install -r, start app using computed package/activity, then force-stop. Capture build/install logs to workspace/.validation.log and write machine-parsable JSON evidence to workspace/.validation_ok. Operates in workspace path and depends on prior steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-mobile-283707-283716/tic_tac_toe_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/.validation.log"
EVIDENCE_JSON="$WORKSPACE/.validation_ok"
: > "$LOG"
# Build
if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then
  ./gradlew assembleDebug >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "build_failed" >>"$LOG"; jq -n --arg e "build_failed" '{status:$e}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 2; }
else
  echo "no_gradle" >>"$LOG"; jq -n --arg e "no_gradle" '{status:$e}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON" 2>/dev/null || exit 3
fi
# Find APK
APK_PATH=""
for p in app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk; do [ -f "$p" ] && APK_PATH="$p" && break || true; done
if [ -z "$APK_PATH" ]; then echo "no_apk_found" >>"$LOG"; jq -n --arg e "no_apk_found" '{status:$e}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"; exit 4; fi
if [ ! -s "$APK_PATH" ]; then echo "apk_empty" >>"$LOG"; jq -n --arg e "apk_empty" '{status:$e}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"; exit 5; fi
# Prepare evidence base
EVID="{\"status\":\"built\",\"apk\":\"$APK_PATH\"}"
# If adb present, check devices and install
if command -v adb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # list devices and states
  adb_out=$(adb devices 2>>"$LOG" || true)
  # parse lines after header
  devices=$(echo "$adb_out" | awk 'NR>1{print $1":"$2}') || true
  if [ -z "$devices" ]; then
    echo "no_device_attached" >>"$LOG"; jq -n --arg s "no_device_attached" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
  else
    # pick first device and its state
    first=$(echo "$devices" | head -n1)
    dev=$(echo "$first" | cut -d: -f1)
    state=$(echo "$first" | cut -d: -f2)
    case "$state" in
      device)
        adb -s "$dev" install -r "$APK_PATH" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || echo "adb_install_failed" >>"$LOG"
        PKG=$(sed -n 's/.*package="\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml || true)
        [ -z "$PKG" ] && PKG="com.example.tictactoe"
        ACTIVITY="${PKG}.MainActivity"
        adb -s "$dev" shell am start -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || echo "start_failed" >>"$LOG"
        sleep 1
        adb -s "$dev" shell am force-stop "$PKG" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || echo "force_stop_failed" >>"$LOG"
        jq -n --arg s "installed_started_stopped" --arg dev "$dev" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,device:$dev,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
        ;;
      unauthorized)
        echo "device_unauthorized:$dev" >>"$LOG"
        jq -n --arg s "device_unauthorized" --arg dev "$dev" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,device:$dev,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
        ;;
      offline)
        echo "device_offline:$dev" >>"$LOG"
        jq -n --arg s "device_offline" --arg dev "$dev" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,device:$dev,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
        ;;
      *)
        echo "device_unknown_state:$state" >>"$LOG"
        jq -n --arg s "device_unknown" --arg state "$state" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,state:$state,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
        ;;
    esac
  fi
else
  echo "adb_missing" >>"$LOG"
  jq -n --arg s "adb_missing" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
fi
# Clean workspace build artifacts to keep tidy
if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then ./gradlew clean >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true; fi

set -euo pipefail

# Validation step: build APK, install/start/stop on attached device, record logs and JSON evidence
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-mobile-283707-283716/tic_tac_toe_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/.validation.log"

: > "$LOG"

# Build
if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then
  ./gradlew assembleDebug >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || {
    echo "build_failed" >>"$LOG"
    jq -n --arg e "build_failed" '{status:$e}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 2
  }
else
  echo "no_gradle" >>"$LOG"
  jq -n --arg e "no_gradle" '{status:$e}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON" 2>/dev/null || exit 3
fi

# Locate APK
APK_PATH=""
for p in app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk; do
  [ -f "$p" ] && APK_PATH="$p" && break || true
done
if [ -z "$APK_PATH" ]; then
  echo "no_apk_found" >>"$LOG"
  jq -n --arg e "no_apk_found" '{status:$e}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
  exit 4
fi
if [ ! -s "$APK_PATH" ]; then
  echo "apk_empty" >>"$LOG"
  jq -n --arg e "apk_empty" '{status:$e}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
  exit 5
fi

# Base evidence
jq -n --arg s "built" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,apk:$apk}' > /tmp/.validation_base.json 2>/dev/null || true

# If adb available, inspect devices and attempt install/start/stop
if command -v adb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  adb devices >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
  adb_out=$(adb devices 2>>"$LOG" || true)
  # parse lines after header
  devices=$(echo "$adb_out" | awk 'NR>1 && NF{print $1":"$2}') || true
  if [ -z "$devices" ]; then
    echo "no_device_attached" >>"$LOG"
    jq -n --arg s "no_device_attached" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
  else
    first=$(echo "$devices" | head -n1)
    dev=$(echo "$first" | cut -d: -f1)
    state=$(echo "$first" | cut -d: -f2)
    case "$state" in
      device)
        echo "device_found:$dev" >>"$LOG"
        # Try install (replace) and capture result
        if adb -s "$dev" install -r "$APK_PATH" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then
          INSTALL_STATUS="ok"
        else
          INSTALL_STATUS="install_failed"
          echo "adb_install_failed" >>"$LOG"
        fi
        # Determine package from manifest if present
        PKG=$(sed -n 's/.*package="\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml || true)
        [ -z "$PKG" ] && PKG="com.example.tictactoe"
        # Start activity (best-effort)
        if adb -s "$dev" shell am start -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then
          START_STATUS="started"
        else
          START_STATUS="start_failed"
          echo "start_failed" >>"$LOG"
        fi
        sleep 1
        if adb -s "$dev" shell am force-stop "$PKG" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then
          STOP_STATUS="stopped"
        else
          STOP_STATUS="force_stop_failed"
          echo "force_stop_failed" >>"$LOG"
        fi
        jq -n --arg s "installed_started_stopped" --arg dev "$dev" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" --arg install "$INSTALL_STATUS" --arg start "$START_STATUS" --arg stop "$STOP_STATUS" '{status:$s,device:$dev,apk:$apk,install:$install,start:$start,stop:$stop}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
        ;;
      unauthorized)
        echo "device_unauthorized:$dev" >>"$LOG"
        jq -n --arg s "device_unauthorized" --arg dev "$dev" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,device:$dev,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
        ;;
      offline)
        echo "device_offline:$dev" >>"$LOG"
        jq -n --arg s "device_offline" --arg dev "$dev" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,device:$dev,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
        ;;
      *)
        echo "device_unknown_state:$state" >>"$LOG"
        jq -n --arg s "device_unknown" --arg state "$state" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,state:$state,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
        ;;
    esac
  fi
else
  echo "adb_missing" >>"$LOG"
  jq -n --arg s "adb_missing" --arg apk "$APK_PATH" '{status:$s,apk:$apk}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON"
fi

# Clean build artifacts to keep workspace tidy (best-effort)
if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then
  ./gradlew clean >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
fi

# Exit 0 if evidence file exists, otherwise non-zero
if [ -f "$EVIDENCE_JSON" ]; then
  exit 0
else
  echo "evidence_missing" >>"$LOG"
  jq -n --arg e "evidence_missing" '{status:$e}' > "$EVIDENCE_JSON" 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 6
fi
